benchmark_suite: HYBA Golden Fold Regime Standarized Benchmark Portfolio

methodology.description: Information geometry of recursive Golden Ratio (phi) folding and quasi-Monte Carlo search structures. Tests examine lossless compression, spectral gap coherence, and intelligence conservation under high-density quantization regimes.
methodology.hardware_validation_environment: HYBA AccelExecutionEngine T1-T3 Shared Shared-Memory (CXL Cache Coherent)

metrics.folding_factor_explanation: The effective dimensional compression ratio of recursive phi-folding on standard byte arrays.
metrics.reconstruction_error_explanation: The L2-norm distance between reconstructed unfolded bytes and the bit-exact native original bytes.
metrics.coherence_gain_explanation: The relative increase in structural/spectral gap coherence under near-state representation.
metrics.intelligence_preservation_explanation: The relative maintainability of model perplexity and downstream task capability pre-fold vs post-unfold.
